architecture.decision: Keep the correction inside the existing seed-baseline component. Reorder prepare() into read-only validation followed by mutation, reusing context(), regular(), load() and stage(). Validate the external request before ticket content access; reject symlinked ticket path components before reading README or intent. Validate reservation, intent binding, seed digests and the allowed inventory before appending authorization or staging. Accommodate only the exact allocator-created README and intent during preparation's pre-mutation inventory check; preserve strict untracked-file rejection for other callers and retain final stage verification. Reuse the validated request instead of reloading an unchecked files map. Add focused preparation regressions to the existing test module. Before later implementation, re-observe ticket-361's historical ownership and current controller evidence, reuse matching authorized work where applicable, and respect the governance workstream's WIP limit without inferring ownership from timeout. Implementation must remain within the local 30-minute active-session limit.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded source and regression changes through the existing governed delivery process if necessary; preserve adopter data, existing reservations and independent publication controls.
